method.hermes: 0.21.5 clean source for both arms; HADES arm loads current sitecustomize overlay
method.reasoning: disabled in both direct AIAgent instances
method.runtime: same isolated rootless Docker daemon and immutable sandbox image; containers network=none
method.subject: synthetic owner identity; private fixture only
method.workspace_registration: Both profiles call Hermes register_task_env_overrides(task_id, {cwd: host workspace, cwd_source: session, env_type: docker}) before the turn, matching Hermes gateway/TUI workspace lifecycle and Docker session isolation. HADES overlay may perform the same registration again for its authenticated owner policy.

image_verification: The rootful registry-pulled digest and rootless Docker-loaded image had matching Config and RootFS layer arrays. A temporary test wrapper delegated immutable repository-digest inspection to rootful Docker after comparing Config+RootFS, then translated docker run from the digest name to the rootless image ID. Workspace containers still ran rootless with docker_network=false.
methodology: Two order-balanced repeats per stack; same Hermes 0.21.5, Qwen3.6 35B digest, Ollama 0.35.1, requested 65,536 context, pinned sandbox image content, private fixtures, direct AIAgent. No UI, memory or production services.
interpretation: Both profiles passed effective terminal checks in all four turns: env_type=docker, cwd=/workspace, mounted host workspace registered for that session, networking disabled. The runtime host_cwd equaled each profile fixture workspace.
Both stacks read the token and returned the correct answer in 2/2 turns, with one read_file call and two model generations per turn. This is equal task completion on the tiny sample.

Median run_conversation time was 12.707 s HADES / 13.234 s PLAIN; outer wall medians were 16.038 s / 15.139 s. First model content was absent before tool choice; these are total turn times and not TTFT. n=2 and not a stable speed ranking.

HADES exposed five schemas / 9,346 serialized bytes; PLAIN exposed eight / 12,590 bytes, including dynamic tool-search wrappers. These narrow direct-profile measurements are not owner preference or broad capability evidence.
limitations: One synthetic file read only; no owner preference, coding/edit, test, Git, follow-up or UI behavior.
Two order-balanced samples per profile; runtime/model latency variance is high.
Direct AIAgent route excludes Open WebUI persistence/auth and full Hermes gateway behavior.
Requested context was 65,536; Ollama effective context must be read from current runtime if reused.
Rootless engine was temporary. The wrapper compared image config and rootfs layers against the verified registry digest, then ran the rootless Docker-loaded equivalent by immutable local image ID.
